title: Coefficient-norm bound for the radial integral
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let ω : ℝ^P → Λ_{m+1}(ℝ^P) be any (m+1)-form (DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m+1); no regularity is assumed) with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(y)) ≤ 1 for every y ∈ ℝ^P, let x ∈ ℝ^P, and let β ∈ Λ_m(ℝ^P) be an m-covector with β(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for every v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m, where (x, v) := Fin.cons x v and the integral is the interval integral over [0, 1]. Then covectorEuclideanNorm(β) ≤ P^{2m+1}·‖x‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (x : Eucl P) (β : Covector (Eucl P) m), (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω y) ≤ 1) → (∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, β v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * ω (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ (2 * m + 1) * ‖x‖
